text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"Dear Mom and Dad, today is the Oaks. The 
'Snow Angel' craze is still going strong. 
(I gotta show 'em what I've got with my 
running, too!)"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"...Everyone had such huge expectations 
for that other girl's running, like I 
mentioned before. I was super jealous of 
that."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"Th-That's why... I wanna win. I don't 
know how to put it into words, but I felt 
like if I beat her, somethin' would 
change."
